messages:
devon_support: HS customer AcmeMaps reporting 503s + extreme latency on their Dedicated cluster 'na-south-1' since ~09:10 UTC. Also seeing billing webhooks show duplicate usage events :confused: 

maria_ops: saw placement failures in autoscaler logs starting 09:09. lots of 'no compatible hosts' errors. tagging @henry_sre 

henry_sre: on it. quick check: autoscaler error dump ->
```
autoscaler: place_request(tenant=acmemaps, gpu=8) -> 8/8 failed: no-compatible-hosts
hostmgr: host 10.2.3.45 flagged: GPU_MEM_RESERVED=92%, preemptible=false
```

lia_eng: customer says they hit auth 401s for some requests too; curious if tokens are being reissued during failover? they pasted sample: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://inference.na-south.redwood/api/v1/gen` -> 401 sometimes

henry_sre: checking infra metrics. na-south1 pool has 6 nodes with >95% GPU mem + OOM evictions from one tenant (media-encoder-prod). KV cache thrashing. looks like noisy neighbor + concurrent scale-downs.

henry_sre: quick repro steps I ran:
```
# list pool usage
rbctl pool show na-south1-dedicated --json | jq '.pools[] | {name, total_gpus, allocated_gpus, reserved_gpus, backpressure}'
# sample output truncated
{"name":"na-south1-dedicated","total_gpus":64,"allocated_gpus":61,"reserved_gpus":2,"backpressure":true}
```

maria_ops: customer also sent billing mismatch screenshot where two start events emitted for same session id. possibly retries from client after 503s. flagged for billing team.

devon_support: priority: P1 customer-impacting. requested temporary mitigation: failover traffic to another region (na-west2) + place a reserve capacity bump.

henry_sre: immediate mitigations I can do: 1) pin autoscaler min to avoid scale-down race 2) add temporary 8-GPU reserve to na-south1 3) enable region fallback for AcmeMaps to na-west2. Doing 1 and 2 now.

henry_sre: executed:
```
rbctl autoscaler update na-south1-dedicated --min-instances 8 --force
rbctl capacity allocate --pool na-south1-dedicated --reserve 8 --reason "emergency noisy-tenant mitigation"
```
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: route-adjust/na-south-fallback -> started at 2026-03-17T09:25:10Z, deploying 3 steps

lia_eng: I pushed a small client-side patch to backoff retries to avoid duplicate billing events, asked AcmeMaps to upgrade SDK.

maria_ops: billing team acked, will suppress duplicate start events for the session ID on ingestion side as a short-term fix.

henry_sre: fallback route set for AcmeMaps to na-west2 (transparent failover):
```
rbctl route set --tenant acmemaps --primary na-south1-dedicated --fallback na-west2-dedicated --timeout 120s
```

henry_sre: metrics after fixes (09:30 UTC): 503s -> dropped from ~12% to ~1.5%, p95 latency from 1200ms -> 320ms. still some tail errors due to the noisy tenant GC cycle.

devon_support: relay to customer: we performed reserve bump + fallback; asking them to retry and confirm.

maria_ops: logged postmortem ticket and assigned to infra-runway and quota team to review autoscaler heuristics and noisy-tenant isolation (ticket INF-2026-149).

lia_eng: next steps: replicate noisy workload on staging to reproduce KV cache evictions and write mitigations (per-tenant GPU mem caps + eviction backoff).

henry_sre: long-term: tune scale-down cooldowns, enforce per-tenant GPU reservations, and consider preemptible eviction policy for best-effort tenants.

devon_support: customer confirmed partial recovery at 09:38 UTC, still seeing some 500s on large jobs only. offered temporary quota increase if they need capacity.

maria_ops: marking incident as ongoing until noisy tenant is throttled or segregated. will update every hour. :hourglass: 

henry_sre: adding note — billing duplicates look caused by client + retry loop; not storage or billing ingest bug. Lia's client patch should help.

devon_support: thanks everyone. I'll keep the customer updated and close once they confirm stable for 6 hours. :white_check_mark:
